owner_taste_model_delta.SPARSE_ACCENT_HIERARCHY: CONFIRMED_SUPPORTING_SIGNAL only: existing OWNER law explicitly prefers sparse accents after macro silhouette/value structure; this cycle supports relational chroma hierarchy as a QC aid but does not create a universal one-accent or numeric chroma-threshold law.

self_model_delta.ACCENT_COMPETITION_RULE: A second high-chroma mass can destroy focal uniqueness even when both colors are individually attractive; measure top-vs-second chroma competition before adding more accents.
self_model_delta.CHROMA_HIERARCHY_RULE: Judge color emphasis relationally: a focal accent is useful when it remains distinctly stronger than supporting chroma, not merely because its saturation is numerically high.
self_model_delta.COLOR_CONFIDENCE_RULE: Synthetic Lab separation is a diagnostic for hierarchy behavior, not a production taste threshold; require approved real-raster transfer before promoting the skill beyond PARTIAL.
